'''''Yagmar''''' were a pair of [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].

==History==
The shuttles arrived with three [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] called ''[[Sunnida]]''. When the freighters were inspected by a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] at a customs checkpoint, ''[[Sunnida 1]]'' was found to contain [[Narcotic incense|narcotics]] instead of [[Stimstick/Legends|stimsticks]] in the other two. The shuttles turned hostile and attempted to shoot down the fighter but were instead destroyed, and ''Sunnida 1'' was disabled and taken to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] navy yard.

==Legacy==
The event was recorded and recreated for the [[Combat chamber]] as part of a training mission for future [[TIE pilot|pilots]]. [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] trained on this mission.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|FRT Sunnida and SHU Yagmar you have entered Alliance Space|Instructor|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''</ref>}}
''Yagmar'' first appears in the [[1994]] video game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], in the [[Combat chamber]] TIE Interceptor mission "Threat Display." The craft are yellow in the [[Combat Multi-view Display]] and are to be the first targets that become hostile. The shuttles are to be inspected to find "Smugglers" inside their cargo as part of a "Bonus" objective.

The shuttles appear again in the [[1997]] video game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'', in the training mission "Inspection," which is the same mission and can be played not only from the Imperials' perspective with any Imperial craft of the player's choice, such as the [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]] or the [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]], but also from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels']] perspective with a Rebel starfighter of the player's choice. If the player takes the Rebel version, ''Yagmar'', instead of carrying Smugglers, will carry Imperials and can be destroyed to gain points.
